lists.name: chats
lists.note: Device-local chat indexing controls (enabled, discovery and roots are privacy decisions for the person) and the session recap, which spends the person's usage. The default `cmux chat` target is a CLI default the person may ask an agent to set.

help.text: Show chats stored on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
Find harness chat folders automatically. When off, only the listed folders are used.
Add absolute paths to harness data folders. Protected folders are refused. Your organization can add locked folders.

summary.text: Extra folders to read chats from

help.text: When you come back to a Claude chat after 5 minutes or more, show a line on where it stands. Each recap is one small extra model call that counts toward your usage.

rows.name: chatOn
rows.note: The default target of `cmux chat` (cli/chat_start.rs): here, cloud, vm:new, vm:ID|NAME, or a device id or name. `--on` and then CMUX_ON come first; empty is here. The CLI reads it through settings.get only when both are absent, and `cmux config set on TARGET` is the CLI's short name for this key (cli/app/settings.rs). Leo, 2026-11-07: "cmux chat is normal, and cmux chat with the flag/arguments can separate if you want it on a different device/vm/cloud/whatevret".

help.text: Where cmux chat starts a chat when neither --on nor CMUX_ON names one: here, cloud, vm:new, vm:NAME, or a device name. Empty is here.
